class.name: HEGoGraphPicking
class.brief_description: Screen-space picking for graph points and connections.

method.name: closest_point
method.description: Index of the projected point closest to [param mouse] within [param radius], or -1.

method.name: distance_to_segment
method.description: Distance from [param mouse] to the segment [param a]–[param b] in 2D.

method.name: closest_connection
method.description: Index of the connection whose projected segment is closest to [param mouse], or -1.

method.name: points_in_rect
method.description: Indices whose projected positions lie inside [param rect].

method.name: connections_in_rect
method.description: Connection indices whose projected midpoint lies inside [param rect].

method.name: closest_on_segment
method.description: Closest point on segment [param a]–[param b] to [param point].

constants.constant: Pixel radius a click must be within to hit a point.
Pixel radius a click must be within to hit a connection.
